raw_cluster_finite_m_analysis.primary_rate_variance_formula: Sj~Poisson(T*A*(Kj/M)*hj); Var_rate_at_M=A^2*Var_p(h)/M, with per-block selected yield h as the primary rate variable
raw_cluster_finite_m_analysis.q_selection_probability_diagnostic: E_p(q^2) uses sum[(K/M)*s*(s-1)/(n*(n-1))] and removes Binomial transport noise, but raw n share is measurably not K/M, so q alone is not the selected-rate M variance
